checks.item: F1: quantifiers, admissible domain and exact counterexample
checks.result: The rank-one family and exact rational bounds were checked. The true root is 1, while the printed interval is [13/12,11/8]; the repaired sign-dependent interval is [11/12,11/8]. The report now explicitly distinguishes strictly positive Hardy-domain functions on the compact cube (or uniformly positive bounded functions) from unrestricted pointwise-positive bounded functions. In the latter literal interpretation infimum zero makes the terminal strict condition infeasible; the counterexample is not falsely claimed to satisfy that unrestricted reading.

The endpoint-sign error occurs in the certified-root enclosure mechanism. A local corrected inequality is established; this does not recompute the final dimension certificate or establish that the paper's numerical dimension is false. Major remains appropriate for the demonstrated core derivation error.

checks.item: F2: density claim, contrary evidence and local replacement
checks.result: The Holder obstruction using |x|^alpha rules out the stated analytic-density argument in the standard C^alpha norm. The positivity/compactness replacement was checked with the Hardy supremum norm and necessary complexification. It supplies a local repair route without treating the original cited density claim as valid.

independent_acceptance_check.result: Accepted after the controlled quantifier/domain clarification and precise repair-scope wording. Two existing Major Problems are retained; no new Problem or whole-paper falsity claim is added.
